question: Which of the following Hindi novels is written by Vishnu Prabhakar?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ardhanarishwar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Ardhanarishwar** is a renowned Hindi novel written by **Vishnu Prabhakar**.
 
• Vishnu Prabhakar was an eminent Indian author known for his contribution to Hindi literature and plays.
 
• The novel **Ardhanarishwar** explores themes of gender, societal norms, and the balance between masculine and feminine energies.
 
• It delves into the philosophical concept of Ardhanarishwar, which symbolizes the synthesis of male and female principles in Indian spirituality.
 
• Vishnu Prabhakar's writings often reflect social issues and human values, and **Ardhanarishwar** is considered one of his significant works.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vishnu Prabhakar:**

 
 
• Born on 21 June 1912, Vishnu Prabhakar was a celebrated Hindi writer.
 
• He received the prestigious **Sahitya Akademi Award** and **Padma Bhushan** for his contributions to literature.
 
• His works often revolved around human struggles, societal challenges, and historical contexts.
 
 
 
• **Ardhanarishwar Symbolism:**
 
 
• The concept of Ardhanarishwar originates from Indian mythology, representing the union of Lord Shiva and Goddess Parvati in a single form.
 
• It signifies the coexistence and balance of masculine and feminine energies in the universe.
 
 
 
• **Hindi Literature:**
 
 
• Hindi literature is one of the richest literary traditions in India, encompassing poetry, novels, plays, and essays.
 
• Authors like Premchand, Mahadevi Varma, and Vishnu Prabhakar have significantly shaped modern Hindi literature.
 
 
 
• **Other Works by Vishnu Prabhakar:**
 
 
• Some of his notable works include **Aawara Masiha**, a biography of Sarat Chandra Chattopadhyay, and several plays and novels addressing social reform.
